Good news — as a Swiss citizen you do not need a visa for a two-week holiday in Vietnam.

1. Primary pathway: Switzerland is on Vietnam's unilateral visa-exemption list, so you can enter visa-free for tourism.
2. Key details: Visa-free stays are allowed for up to 45 days, well within your 14-day trip. This exemption is valid through 2028-08-14 (per Resolution 229/NQ-CP). Just make sure your passport is valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.
3. E-Visa fallback: You don't need it, but if you ever wanted more flexibility (e.g., a longer stay or multiple entries), an e-Visa is available to all nationalities for up to 90 days, costing USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), applied for at evisa.gov.vn.
4. Data caveat: This information is current as of 2026-08-17. Since exemption terms can change, it's worth double-checking at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
